Title: Generally Available: Azure Storage Actions – Serverless storage data management

Body.Content:
Azure Storage Actions, our fully managed platform that transforms how organizations automate data management tasks for Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage, is now generally available in select Azure regions. 

 

Azure Storage Actions enables you to quickly compose and deploy tasks that can scan, analyze and process billions of objects across multiple storage accounts without requiring any programming skills. You can use blob tags and metadata as parameters in conditions and operations for dynamic flexibility in how each object is processed. Results are easily monitored through dashboards with rapid drill downs to individual operations. Combining a no-code experience with serverless infrastructure, Azure Storage Actions eliminates complexity, boosts efficiency and drives consistency. 

 

Supported use cases include managing retention and expiry, reducing costs, data protection, consistent tag management, restore from archive, with more to come. 

 

With general availability, you can now use Azure Storage Actions to manage the largest Storage deployments with confidence.  

Learn more: 

  • To learn more, please see the Azure blog.  
  • To get started, refer to the quickstart guide.  
  • Check out the documentation for details and region availability.
